detail: Decisions: Chose lazy TTL-gated git-HEAD probe on tool dispatch over fs.watch on .twining/records/ for live re-ingest — assemble is itself a tool call so acceptance ('assemble sees pulled records without restart') is met exactly, while fs.watch adds watcher lifecycle, self-triggered events from our own exports, and platform quirks in a long-lived stdio process. Polling timers rejected too: they keep the event loop alive and burn cycles when idle.; Chose a new sync-manager module reusing branch-watcher's snapshot-and-diff pattern instead of literally extending src/engine/branch-watcher.ts — that module is the housekeeping deleted-branch sweep with a different trigger (housekeeping runs) and signal (branch deletion); grafting HEAD-movement detection onto it would couple two unrelated lifecycles.; Chose hash-based re-embedding (embeddings.content_hash column, schema v2) with NULL-hash backfill-without-re-embed — pulled decision status changes are the common ingest update and leave embed text unchanged, so hash comparison makes them free; NULL backfill avoids a one-time mass re-embed at migration since record embed-text is immutable in practice.
summary: W2.3 phase 2 started on claude/w23-phase2-live-ingest. First commit: FOUNDATION-PLAN.md status section reconciling plan doc to shipped reality (W0–W2.3p1 done, phase 2 in progress, W3 next).
